run_vg_cls_overlap_main: run the script to analyze class vocabulary overlap between Visual Genome and Something-Something v2 datasets
run_get_dataset_cls: run get_dataset_cls to extract object class vocabulary from VG, Flickr30k, Open Image, SS2, or ANet datasets
run_load_corpus: run load_corpus to load and return sentences from Flickr30k, SS2, or ANet grounding datasets
review_get_dataset_cls: review get_dataset_cls which uses Stanford CoreNLP to lemmatize class names and filter by frequency threshold
review_main: review main which compares two dataset class dictionaries and reports missing vocabulary with corpus frequency
